name: example
_comment: A runnable plan for Scripts/bridge-orchestrator.mjs. Every field here is a
real puerts_blueprint_build / puerts_blueprint_graph_patch field; nothing is
an orchestrator invention except name, expect and repair_operations.
It authors a Blueprint under /Game/MCPGenerated/ (the only root native
authoring accepts), asks the independent inspector whether the component,
the variable and the graph really arrived, and if they did not, applies one
expect.min_nodes is 3 and not 4, because the plan states four nodes and one
of them is a Comment. Set it to what you require, not to what you hope for:
an expectation copied from the spec turns the read-back into a tautology.
Delete this _comment key before using it as a template for anything real.
